Even R1 Ring Exporter for Mac
How it works Requirements Guides

Public alpha for Mac

Ask ChatGPT about your Even R1 ring.

Set it up once. Your Mac automatically collects your ring’s sleep and activity readings. Ask ChatGPT about them whenever you want, without exporting or uploading files yourself.

Install with Codex → Download Mac exporter (.dmg) ↓

Apple silicon · macOS 14 or later

How it works

  1. Wear your Even R1 ring

    Wear the R1 and sync it with Even on your iPhone. Your G2 glasses and ring keep their usual pairing.

  2. Let your Mac collect automatically

    Turn on scheduling once during setup. The collector opens Even and saves the export when your Mac is awake, unlocked and idle. You can quit the exporter window.

  3. Ask ChatGPT

    Set up Even R1 Ring Data for ChatGPT to give your own ChatGPT account read-only access to the measurements. Keep the Mac awake and online when you ask a question.

What can I ask
ChatGPT?

Ask about recorded nights, your latest readings or changes the Mac has observed since collection began.

Choose a sample question

“How much did I sleep each night over the last seven days?”

Nights are grouped by the date you woke up. A missing date means Even supplied no sleep session for that date.

“What are my latest step count and active calories?”

The answer includes the values and their age as shown by Even. A reading taken partway through the day may be a partial total.

“What was my last heart rate reading, and how old is it?”

You can ask about heart rate, heart rate variability, blood oxygen saturation and changes in skin temperature whenever Even displays them.

What you’ll need

You can try a local export before connecting ChatGPT.

Hardware
An Even R1 ring, an iPhone and a Mac with Apple silicon. The pilot setup also paired Even G2 glasses to the iPhone. See the official R1 photos.
Even on your Mac
Open the Mac App Store on your Mac. Search for Even Realities under iPhone & iPad Apps. Install the app marked “Designed for iPhone” by Even Realities Ltd. Open the Even Realities listing.
Ring sync
Use the same Even account on your iPhone and Mac. Enable “Cloud processing & backup” in Even to sync across devices. Check that a reading from the iPhone appears in Even on the Mac.
Mac exporter
Install Even R1 Ring Exporter for Mac from this site. Codex can download it, help you grant permissions, test the first export and enable scheduled collection. Open the installation guide.
ChatGPT access
For web access, use a ChatGPT account that can add a custom MCP server, an OpenAI Platform organization with tunnel access and a dedicated API key.
Data sharing
Your ZIP archives stay on the Mac. When you ask the connector a question, OpenAI receives the readings it returns. Each person uses their own tunnel and key.
